name: TOFSense-F2
description: Low-cost 25 m single-point dToF ranger with a 1-2° beam, 100 Hz and 100 klux sunlight immunity. UART, I2C or I/O on one 4-pin GH1.25 plug. Cheap long-range option for robots and drones.

variants.note: GH1.25 4-pin, shared by all modes: V G R T (UART), V G D C (I2C), V G H L (I/O). Price is Waveshare's 'TOF Laser Range Sensor (C)' (SKU 28760), which uses Nooploop's NLink_TOFSense protocol and matches this spec.

kicad.footprintNote: Ready-made module: wire it up with a connector or header

notes: Nooploop sells through distributors (Buy&Contact on its site, no list price). Waveshare sells the same sensor under its own name
Datasheet V2.0 table gives 100 Hz for the F2 (series max 350 Hz on the older TOFSense-F). UART default 921600 baud; I2C address 0x08 + ID, up to 400 kHz
Datasheet gives no reflectivity for the 25 m figure (indoor tests). Std dev <1 cm to 10 m, <6 cm from 10-25 m; reads 0 m beyond 25 m, so check the status field
905 nm laser: Nooploop says the Class 1 certification for 905/940 nm is under review; Waveshare lists it as Class 1. Older TOFSense-F / F P use a 750-830 nm Class 2 laser
250 mW at 5 V (about 50 mA) in UART active output; 3.3 V TTL signals. TOFSense-F2 P (50 m) and F2 Mini (7.8 m) are separate models

specs.eyeSafety: Laser 905 nm; Class 1 per Waveshare (Nooploop certification under review)
